data.name: Sneak Attack
data.description: At 5th level, a sandman inflicts +%1d6 points of damage against targets within 30 feet that he flanks or that are denied their Dex bonus to AC against him. This damage increases by +1d6 every five levels after 5th. This ability replaces lore master.|(BardLVL/5)+1
